process_description: CANONICAL unified timeline view. Assembles events from all sources (documents, journal, deadlines, issues, manual entries) into a single chronological list with filtering by date range, source, and severity. This is the primary view for the tenant timeline page. CANONICAL date range metadata for the user's timeline. Returns the earliest and latest event dates, plus the span in days. Used by the timeline UI for navigation and default view. CANONICAL manual creation of a timeline event. The tenant can add events that aren't from documents — conversations, phone calls, visits, observations. Each event has a date, title, description, and optional severity. Build deterministic timeline chronology from cloud events and indexed document metadata.
